title: Sinner Fein
html_source: Sinn Féin is an Irish republican political party dedicated to the reunification of Ireland and an end to British administration in Northern Ireland. It was founded in 1905, so it would be an active movement in 1904. Is Molly making a joke of their name or actually mistaking it?
